description: This file provides the implementation of the FormService interface in the OpenMRS API, managing creation, retrieval, updating, duplication, and deletion of forms, form fields, and related resources. It includes methods for handling form-related data operations, validation, locking, and copying resources.

classes.name: FormServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the FormService interface, providing CRUD operations, duplication, merging, validation, and resource management functionalities for forms within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a form by ID.

methods.name: duplicateForm
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing form, including its form fields and resources.

methods.name: retireForm
methods.description: Marks a form as retired with an optional reason.

methods.name: unretireForm
methods.description: Reverts a retired form to active status.

methods.name: getAllFieldTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all field types, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by ID.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a field by ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a form field by ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a form field matching specific criteria.

methods.name: getFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldAnswerByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field answer by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a field type by name.

methods.name: getFormByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a form by UUID.

methods.name: getFormFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a form field by UUID.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Retrieves all fields, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getAllFormFields
methods.description: Retrieves all form fields.

methods.name: getAllForms
methods.description: Retrieves all forms, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves the form with the highest version matching the given name.

methods.name: getForms
methods.description: Retrieves forms matching various criteria.

methods.name: getFormCount
methods.description: Counts forms matching specific criteria.

methods.name: getPublishedForms
methods.description: Retrieves all published (non-retired) forms.

methods.name: purgeField
methods.description: Deletes a field, optionally cascaded.

methods.name: purgeForm
methods.description: Permanently deletes a form.

methods.name: purgeForm
methods.description: Permanently deletes a form, with cascade option.

methods.name: purgeFormField
methods.description: Deletes a form field.

methods.name: retireField
methods.description: Marks a field as retired.

methods.name: saveField
methods.description: Saves or updates a field.

methods.name: saveForm
methods.description: Validates and saves or updates a form.

methods.name: saveFormField
methods.description: Saves or updates a form field, including handling complex obs handlers.

methods.name: unretireField
methods.description: Reverts a retired field to active.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields based on various filters.

methods.name: getFieldsByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves fields associated with a specific concept.

methods.name: getFormsContainingConcept
methods.description: Retrieves forms that contain a specific concept.

methods.name: purgeFieldType
methods.description: Deletes a field type.

methods.name: saveFieldType
methods.description: Saves or updates a field type.

methods.name: mergeDuplicateFields
methods.description: Merges duplicate fields based on similarity criteria.
